cluster: run the cluster function to compute self-supervised cluster assignments and evaluate NMI, purity, and entropy metrics
get_cluster_assignments_gpu: run get_cluster_assignments_gpu to aggregate multi-head features and solve label assignment via sinkhorn-knopp
optimize_L_sk_gpu: run optimize_L_sk_gpu to perform sinkhorn-knopp optimization and return cluster labels with transport cost
match_order: run match_order to align cluster assignments between audio and video modalities by optimizing permutation
cluster_evaluate: evaluate clustering quality by computing normalized mutual information and adjusted mutual information against true labels
